reviews.title: GOAT mascara
reviews.body: This is the best tubing mascara! My personal hall of fame mascara. I wanted mascara that would come off without rubbing / tugging at my eyes, yet it needs to stay on as long as I need them to. This mascara does it all! It applies easily and actually elongates my lashes. It's not sticky once it dries (which it does quickly). It also lasts for my entire work day in all sorts of weather. The wand is easy to use and helps with combing out the mascara. The mascara comes off with water without leaving dark smears in the corners of my eyes. In fact, this mascara came off completely with tears when I was crying my rubbing my eyes just yesterday. As for eye drops, the mascara stays put if I only use 2-3 drops in each eye. The key is to gingerly dab the corners of your eyes to get rid of the extra eye drops, and not touch the mascara when it's wet again. The mascara re-solidifies after the eyedrops dry out and you'll be good as new! I've purchased many of these so I can leave them in random rooms and at work. Each tube lasts me a long time. The only downside is that the packaging is a bit bulky / heavy so it weighs down my makeup bag when I travel, but it's not a big deal. If they discontinue (or worse, reformulate) these, my stubby lashes will be big sad. ❤️

reviews.title: Beautiful mascara, just not waterproof at all!!
reviews.body: I love this mascara! It makes you have long beautiful lashes. The only issue is when you sweat or they get wet, they just come right out and you have mascara pieces all down your face. I fully suggest that if you think you are going to get wet, being that it’s raining or it’s hot out, get the water proof mascara.

reviews.author: Reed W.
reviews.title: Best Mascara!
reviews.body: This has now become my favorite mascara! My eyes are very sensitive and water easily- regular mascaras always lead to burning and the dreaded running off the sides of my eyes which then turn into me wiping and creating red irritation and black streaks. I’ve been in lash extensions for 6 months and when I wake up in the morning I am confident that this mascara won’t do that to me. The color is perfect but with so many options I would love to try more!
